about: Made-up but realistic UK receipt item lines, each with what it really is (worker/item-kind-core.js KIND_LIST). No real orders or people. Toiletries count as household; hair dryers, straighteners and electric toothbrushes as electronics; candles, plants and paint as home; pet food and pet things as pets; stationery and greetings cards as other; event tickets and delivery charges as services. scripts/test-item-kinds-accuracy.mjs reads it. Groups marked setTwo were written after the rules were first tuned and scored before the rules saw them: 209 of 229 right (91.3%), with 3 of 182 never-wrong lines wrong. The rules were then improved on them too, so the whole file is now tuning data; that first 91.3% is the honest estimate for lines Relay hasn't seen. Groups marked setThree (round 5, 19 Nov 2026) are 330 lines in harder styles (till-roll short forms like "JS BTRNT SQSH", colour and size codes, model numbers, DIY, pets, baby, vapes, gift cards, fees), scored before the rules saw them: 264 of 330 right (80.0%), with 14 never-wrong lines wrong. The rules were then improved on them, so they are tuning data too. Groups marked setFour (68 lines, one already in the file) were written after the round 5 fixes as a check and scored before the rules saw them: 65 of 68 right (95.6%), none of the never-wrong lines wrong; the three misses were then fixed too.
